name: SVGator
description:
Connect Claude to your SVGator account to browse, create, edit, and export animated SVGs through natural conversation.

Once connected, Claude can list and open your SVGator projects (each with a direct editor link), inspect a project's structure, and make precise changes — recolor a shape, retime an animation, add or remove elements, or adjust a single keyframe — using a navigate → read → edit → verify loop that touches only what you ask for. Claude can also build new projects and reusable assets from scratch, duplicate and organize projects into folders, and check your plan details.

When you're ready to ship, Claude exports to the format you need: animated or static SVG (JS or CSS), React Native or Flutter source, Lottie JSON, or a rendered MP4/GIF. Sync formats return a temporary download link; video and GIF run as render jobs Claude polls until the download is ready.

Your SVGator credentials are handled through SVGator's standard OAuth sign-in and stay server-side — they are never exposed to Claude or the model. Claude only ever receives the results of the actions you request.

Requires a SVGator account.

_published_faq.name: How do I add SVGator to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add SVGator to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.svgator.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the SVGator MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: SVGator lists 22 MCP tools, including create_asset, create_folder, create_project, describe_shape, duplicate_project, edit_part, export_project, get_asset, get_folder, get_profile, get_project, and get_render.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to SVGator?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to SVGator in design-creative on the Manufact MCP catalog include Motion, MotionVid, Sleek, Streamloop MCP, and Image Generation.
SVGator requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
SVGator is developed by SVGator. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
